driver_note: Anonymous driver, no registered preferences or history (driver_profile intentionally blank -- a pure situation story). A long, empty, monotonous daytime highway: drowsiness climbs 31 -> 67 -> 100 while fatigue trails behind (23 -> 32 -> 56), and monotony pegs at 100 well before drowsiness does. A short nap at the SA/PA (rest_spot_type=sa_pa, road_type=parking, motion_state=stopped) collapses both drowsiness (100->37) and fatigue (56->4), then the driver gets back on the highway partially refreshed (40/20/35) for stage 5. The content story across the four driving stages (1,2,3,5) is a RISING-THEN-FALLING FIT ARC on the SAME high-arousal energize track (synthetic-track-0266, 'The Seed (2.0)' by Cody ChesnuTT, arousal 0.797) -- the system's confidence in the same pick tracks the driver's degrading state, peaking at stage 3 (fit 0.276) right before the stop, then dropping back down post-rest (stage 5, fit 0.162). The strong before/after story is the SERVICE: stage 4 (after_rest, stopped) switches the top-ranked service entirely away from driving/content services to stretch_video, a physical-recovery activity -- content becomes secondary and its fit collapses to 0.074, since no karaoke-family service reaches the eligible top-3 under a blank profile. Verified against the REAL content+service selectors (scripts/preset_eval.py evaluate_preset) with zero expectation failures across all 5 stages.

brief.en: Mid-morning, an empty monotonous highway, driver is still fresh. Drowsiness is only 31 and the assistant is just playing route music -- a high-arousal energize track already tops the list, but its fit score is low: the system has little reason yet to push hard.
brief.ja: 午前中、単調な高速道路を巡航中でまだ元気。眠気はわずか31、アシスタントは通常のルートミュージックを再生中。高覚醒のエナジャイズ系の曲がすでに1位だが、フィットスコアは低い — システムはまだ強く推す理由がない。

expectation.hypothesis: fresh cruise on a monotonous highway, low drowsiness -> a high-arousal energize track already tops, but confidence (fit) is still low

label.ja: 眠気が高まる — 注意喚起

brief.en: About 36 minutes in, the featureless highway has driven monotony to its ceiling (100) and drowsiness to 67. The assistant switches into inattentive-prevention mode. The exact same energize track holds the top spot -- but now with a visibly higher fit: the system is more confident in the same pick as the driver's state degrades.
brief.ja: 走行約36分、単調な高速道路でモノトニーが上限（100）に達し、眠気も67に上昇。アシスタントは注意喚起モードに切り替わる。同じ高覚醒の曲がそのまま1位を維持するが、フィットスコアは明らかに上昇 — 状態が悪化するほど同じ選曲への確信が強まる。

expectation.hypothesis: drowsiness/monotony climbing (monotony pegs at 100) on the same highway, inattentive-prevention mode -> the SAME high-arousal track holds the top spot, now with a mid fit as the system grows more confident

brief.en: Drowsiness has pegged at 100 and fatigue has climbed to 56 -- the rest threshold is crossed and AICA now recommends a stop. Until the driver actually reaches the SA/PA they are still driving, so the assistant keeps pushing the same energize track, now at its highest fit of the drive: peak confidence right before the stop.
brief.ja: 眠気は上限の100に達し、疲労も56まで上昇 — 休憩の閾値を超え、AICAは休憩を推奨する。SA/PAに着くまではまだ運転中のため、アシスタントは同じエナジャイズ系の曲を推し続け、フィットスコアはこの走行で最高値に — 停車直前が確信のピーク。

expectation.hypothesis: drowsiness pegs at 100, fatigue 56, rest now recommended, still driving -> the SAME high-arousal track tops with its highest fit yet, and the assistant is still offering a driving service to bridge the gap to the stop

label.ja: 仮眠後、リフレッシュして再出発

brief.en: A short nap at the SA/PA has done its job: drowsiness collapsed from 100 to 37 and fatigue from 56 to just 4. Stopped in the parking area, AICA no longer needs to fight sleepiness with music -- the top-ranked service switches entirely to stretch_video, a physical-recovery activity. Content (offered through the fallback music service since no karaoke service reaches the top-3) now scores low: the story has moved from 'push a driving song' to 'help the body recover'.
brief.ja: SA/PAでの短い仮眠が効いた：眠気は100から37へ、疲労は56からわずか4へ低下。駐車エリアで停車中のAICAはもう音楽で眠気と戦う必要がなく、最上位サービスはstretch_video（体を動かす回復系アクティビティ）へ完全に切り替わる。コンテンツ（カラオケ系サービスが上位3に入らないためフォールバックのmusic_playlistで評価）のスコアは低い — 物語は「運転用の曲を推す」から「体の回復を助ける」へと移った。

expectation.hypothesis: after a nap at the SA/PA, drowsiness collapses 100->37 and fatigue collapses 56->4 (stopped, parking) -> the assistant's top SERVICE switches away from any driving/content service to the post-rest recovery service stretch_video; content itself becomes secondary and its fit collapses

brief.en: Back on the highway after the stop, refreshed: drowsiness is only 40, fatigue 20, monotony has not yet rebuilt (35). AICA returns to an ordinary driving service and the same energize track tops again -- at a moderate fit, clearly below the pre-rest peak (0.276) but above the very first fresh-cruise reading (0.150). The arc has come full circle.
brief.ja: 休憩を終えてリフレッシュし、再び高速道路へ。眠気はわずか40、疲労は20、モノトニーはまだ再蓄積していない（35）。AICAは通常の運転サービスに戻り、同じエナジャイズ系の曲が再び1位に — フィットスコアは休憩直前のピーク（0.276）より明らかに低いが、最初の元気な巡航時（0.150）よりは高い。物語は一周した。

expectation.hypothesis: refreshed and back on the highway, drowsiness only 40 -> a driving service leads again and the SAME energize track tops, at a moderate fit -- lower than the pre-rest peak, higher than the very first fresh-cruise reading

label.ja: B・夜のドライブ（休憩アーク）

driver_note.en: Blank driver profile (no oshi, no history, no genre usage) — isolates the situation lever. Same rest arc as the day journey but every stage runs at night_state='night', so the small night context-response leaf (-0.5/+0.5, ~2.7% of total weight) nudges fit and, once the arc reaches the after-rest stage where scores are close, flips which track tops.
driver_note.ja: ドライバープロフィールは空欄（推し・履歴・ジャンル利用なし）— 状況レバーを分離。昼間版と同じ休憩アークだが、全ステージでnight_state='night'。夜間のコンテキスト応答リーフ（-0.5/+0.5、全体重みの約2.7%）がフィットをわずかに動かし、スコアが僅差になる休憩後ステージで首位の曲を入れ替える。

label.ja: B・1/4 — 夜の高速道路 — まだ元気

brief.en: Just underway on a quiet night highway. Drowsiness is mild (31), monotony is light (30). No driver history yet — the situation alone sets a modest fit for the high-arousal track that will carry through the whole night arc.
brief.ja: 静かな夜の高速道路を走り始めたところ。眠気は軽く（31）、単調さも軽い（30）。履歴はまだ無く、状況だけで高覚醒トラックに控えめなフィットが付く — 一晩の物語の起点。

expectation.hypothesis: Night cruise, mild drowsiness → a high-arousal track already leads at a modest fit; this is the floor of the night's rising-fit arc.

brief.en: Drowsiness has climbed to 70 and monotony has pegged at 100 on the dark highway. The inattentive-driving recovery trigger fires. The same high-arousal track's fit rises sharply from stage 1 — situation, not preference, is driving the story.
brief.ja: 眠気は70まで上昇し、単調さは暗い高速道路で100に張り付いた。不注意運転の回復トリガーが発動。同じ高覚醒トラックのフィットが1段階目から急上昇 — 嗜好ではなく状況が物語を牽引。

expectation.hypothesis: Drowsiness spikes and monotony maxes out at night → the same track's fit rises sharply (rising-fit arc); still a driving service.

brief.en: Drowsiness maxes at 100, fatigue reaches 58, monotony stays pegged at 100 — the rest trigger fires before the driver reaches a stop. The high-arousal track's fit peaks here, the highest of the whole night arc, while the service is still a driving one.
brief.ja: 眠気は100に達し、疲労は58、単調さは100のまま — 休憩地点に着く前に休憩トリガーが発動。高覚醒トラックのフィットは一晩の中で最大に達するが、サービスはまだ走行中のもの。

expectation.hypothesis: At the rest trigger drowsiness/fatigue/monotony all peak at night → the track's fit peaks too, still before the stop; service remains a driving service.

label.ja: B・4/4 — 仮眠後に再出発

brief.en: After a nap, drowsiness collapses to 38 and fatigue to 5; the trip moves to after_rest_before_restart, stopped at an SA/PA. The service switches away from driving services to a post-rest one (stretch_video) and the fit resets low since the situational push is gone. At night the winner is the same track as the drive — the day journey's after-rest stage instead crowns a different, higher-arousal track, showing the night leaf's small but real pull.
brief.ja: 仮眠後、眠気は38、疲労は5まで低下。旅程はafter_rest_before_restart（停車中・SA/PA）へ。サービスは走行系から休憩後系（ストレッチ動画）へ切り替わり、状況側の後押しが消えたためフィットは低くリセットされる。夜間はドライブと同じ曲が首位に残るが、昼間バージョンの同ステージでは別のより高覚醒な曲が首位になる — night leafの小さいが確かな影響を示す。

expectation.hypothesis: After a nap at night, situational push collapses and the service switches to a post-rest one (stretch_video/full_karaoke content); fit resets low. Night vs day differ in which track tops this stage.

label.ja: 山道の峠越え（疲労主導・履歴なし）

driver_note: An unknown driver with NO history/oshi/genre data (driver_profile is blank) so the situation alone drives every outcome -- this is a pure situation-lever journey, isolated from preference/history contamination (see recovery discipline). The route is a winding mountain pass (road_type='mountain', route/destination tags ['mountain']), which is NOT monotonous the way a straight highway is -- so this is the FATIGUE-LED counterpart to the monotony-led highway journeys: fatigue is set to lead drowsiness at every driving stage (40>30, 85>75, 40>35), rather than monotony dominating. The mountain road_type also carries its own lever on content: the context_response_matrix's 'road' cell is alpha=-1.00 for mountain (vs +1.00 for highway, 0.00 for local/parking) -- it PULLS the preferred-arousal target down for safety, the opposite direction of a highway. Verified against a same-situation highway control (drow30/fat40/mono45): the highway pick is the identical high-arousal track at a HIGHER fit (0.163 highway vs 0.134 mountain) -- the mountain lever measurably discounts the same energizer track without swapping it out, confirming SITUATION shapes fit magnitude rather than track identity (achievable contrast #1). Across the whole loop the SAME track (synthetic-track-0266, 'The Seed (2.0)' by Cody ChesnuTT, arousal-band high) stays #1 in every driving stage -- proving the mountain lever discounts rather than swaps -- while its fit traces a rising arc with fatigue (0.134 -> 0.193) and collapses after the rest stop (service switches to the post-rest family, stretch_video leads, and content fit for that same energizer style falls to its honest floor ~0.067).

brief.en: Winding mountain road, engaged. Fatigue (40) is already ahead of drowsiness (30) as the curves work the driver harder than the road bores them — this is the fatigue-led shape of a mountain drive, unlike a monotony-led highway.
brief.ja: 曲がりくねった山道、まだ集中している。カーブが単調さより先にドライバーを疲れさせるため、疲労（40）が眠気（30）を上回り始めている — 単調度主導の高速道路とは異なる、山道特有の疲労主導の形。

expectation.hypothesis: fatigue-led mountain climb (fat40>drow30), blank profile -> same high-arousal energizer track tops as it would on a flat road; only the fit magnitude is being shaped by the mountain road's negative arousal-preference lever

brief.en: The winding climb has pushed fatigue (85) well past drowsiness (75) and monotony has crept up too (60) — a rest stop is now recommended. The same energizer track that led on the flat road still leads here, but its pull is much stronger now.
brief.ja: 曲がりくねった登りで疲労（85）が眠気（75）を大きく上回り、単調度も上昇（60）— 休憩が推奨される。平坦な道と同じ元気付け系の曲が引き続き1位だが、その引きは今はずっと強い。

expectation.hypothesis: fatigue has rocketed past drowsiness (85 vs 75) on the winding climb -> the SAME track stays on top (no swap) but its fit rises sharply as the model's energize pull strengthens with fatigue/drowsiness

label.ja: 展望台でストレッチ休憩

brief.en: Stopped at a mountain overlook: fatigue (15) and drowsiness (30) have both dropped sharply after the break. The lifecycle stage switches to the post-rest service family (stretch_video leads) and the same style of track that dominated the drive now scores far lower — the fit floor is honest.
brief.ja: 山の展望台に停車：休憩後、疲労（15）も眠気（30）も大きく低下。ライフサイクル段階が休憩後のサービス群（stretch_videoが1位）に切り替わり、道中を支配していた同系統の曲のスコアも大きく下がる — 正直な下限。

expectation.hypothesis: stopped at the overlook after the stretch break, fatigue/drowsiness collapse back down -> the driving-service ranking is replaced by the post-rest one (stretch_video tops) and content fit for the same style of track falls back near its cold floor

label.en: Back on the pass, fatigue-led again
label.ja: 峠道に戻る — 再び疲労主導

brief.en: Underway again through the curves: fatigue (40) is back ahead of drowsiness (35), mirroring stage 1 almost exactly. The same track and the same driving-service family win again, closing the fatigue-led mountain loop.
brief.ja: 再びカーブを走行：疲労（40）が眠気（35）を上回り、ステージ1とほぼ同じ形に戻る。同じ曲・同じ運転系サービス群が再び勝ち、疲労主導の山道ループが閉じる。

expectation.hypothesis: back on the pass, fatigue-led again and almost identical to stage 1 -> the same energizer track tops again with the same driving-service family, closing the loop

driver_note: An unknown driver — no oshi, no genre usage, no play history (blank profile). This isolates the pure SITUATION effect: gridlock traffic drives drowsiness, fatigue, and monotony up and back down, and the assistant stays in inattentive-driving-prevention mode throughout (never crossing into rest_recommended — this jam never gets bad enough to warrant a rest stop, it just clears). The energize-track's fit should rise as the jam worsens and ease as it clears, while a driving service stays selected the whole time.

brief.en: Traffic just seized up. Drowsiness (45) and fatigue (40) are moderate, monotony is climbing (70) as the stop-and-go grind sets in. The assistant is already in keep-alert mode; the energize pick should show a real but not-yet-peak fit.
brief.ja: 交通が突然詰まった。眠気（45）と疲労（40）は中程度、ストップ&ゴーの単調さで単調度が上昇中（70）。アシスタントはすでに覚醒維持モード。覚醒を促す一曲は、まだピークではないが確かなフィット感を示すはず。

expectation.hypothesis: jam just starting, drowsiness/fatigue moderate and monotony climbing (70) under gridlock → inattentive-prevention already leads with a high-arousal energize track, fit elevated but not yet peaked

brief.en: The gridlock hasn't moved in a while — the worst point of the jam. Drowsiness (70) and fatigue (55) have both climbed and monotony is pegged at 100. The assistant's energize pick should show its highest fit of the whole journey here.
brief.ja: 渋滞は一向に動かない — この渋滞で最悪の局面。眠気（70）と疲労（55）がともに上昇し、単調度は100に張り付く。覚醒を促す一曲のフィット感は、この旅程を通じて最も高くなるはず。

expectation.hypothesis: worst point of the jam: drowsiness 70 + fatigue 55 + monotony pegged at 100 → the energize track's fit peaks for the journey, still inattentive-prevention, still a driving service

brief.en: Traffic finally frees up and speed returns to normal. Drowsiness (55), fatigue (45), and monotony (60) all ease back down from their peak. The assistant keeps the same energize track in the lead, but the fit eases off its stage-2 peak — never reaching rest territory, this jam just resolves on its own.
brief.ja: 渋滞がようやく解消し、速度が正常に戻る。眠気（55）・疲労（45）・単調度（60）はいずれもピークから低下。アシスタントは同じ覚醒トラックを引き続き上位に選ぶが、フィット感はステージ2のピークから和らぐ — 休憩が必要な域には達せず、渋滞は自然に解消する。

expectation.hypothesis: jam clears, drowsiness/fatigue/monotony all ease back down from their stage-2 peak → the same energize track stays on top but its fit eases off the peak, still a driving service

driver_note: Driver profile is fully BLANK (no oshi, no genre usage, no per-track history) on every stage. child_present=True + multiple_passengers=True on every stage instead. This isolates a pure situation+child_present story: with zero personalization, child_present alone swaps the top track away from what an otherwise-identical adult-only drive would pick (verified: same situation with child_present=False tops a different track, 'The Seed (2.0) - Cody ChesnuTT', fit 0.1562). Purpose is mixed and realistic: the three driving legs use child_passenger_experience/active_driving_content; the rest stop uses rest_recommended/after_rest_before_restart (the family's break), which flips the SERVICE ranking to a post-rest activity (stretch_video) while content still resolves through a content-supported service at a lower fit than the driving legs.

brief.en: Morning highway drive, kids and multiple passengers aboard, driver profile completely blank (no oshi, no history, no genre usage). With no personalization signal at all, child_present alone is enough to pick a different, child-appropriate high-arousal track than an otherwise-identical adult-only drive would.
brief.ja: 朝の高速道路、子どもと複数の同乗者が乗車。ドライバープロファイルは完全に空欄（推し・履歴・ジャンル利用なし）。個人化シグナルが一切ない状態でも、child_present（子ども同乗）だけで、大人のみの同一状況とは異なる子ども向けの高覚醒な曲が選ばれる。

expectation.hypothesis: blank profile + child_present on a mild drive -> the child-appropriate high-arousal track tops via humming_karaoke, at a modest fit

measured.top_name: チョコレイト・ディスコ — Perfume

label.ja: E・2/4 — 1時間経過、落ち着かない

brief.en: An hour later: traffic and monotony have built, drowsiness climbs to 55. Same blank profile, same child_present -- the SAME track that led stage 1 stays on top, but its fit score rises with the harder situation (situation moves fit magnitude, not identity).
brief.ja: 1時間後、渋滞と単調さが蓄積し眠気は55まで上昇。同じ空欄プロファイル、同じchild_present — ステージ1で首位だった同じ曲がそのまま首位を維持するが、状況が厳しくなるにつれフィットスコアは上昇する（状況はフィットの大きさを動かすが、識別は変えない）。

expectation.hypothesis: same blank profile, same child_present, but drowsiness/monotony climb -> the SAME child track stays top, fit rises (situation raises fit magnitude, doesn't swap identity)

measured.top_name: チョコレイト・ディスコ — Perfume

label.ja: E・3/4 — 休憩ストップ、みんなでストレッチ

brief.en: A stop at the service area to stretch -- drowsiness drops back to 30, the car is stopped in the parking area. The purpose becomes rest_recommended / after_rest_before_restart: the overall service ranking now favours a post-rest activity (stretch_video) instead of a driving service, and content fit dips below the driving stages.
brief.ja: サービスエリアで休憩ストップ、眠気は30まで回復し車は駐車エリアで停止。目的はrest_recommended／after_rest_before_restartに切り替わり、全体のサービスランキングは走行系サービスではなく休憩後のアクティビティ（stretch_video）を優先。コンテンツのフィットも走行ステージより下がる。

expectation.hypothesis: family stops to stretch: lifecycle flips to after_rest_before_restart -> the overall service ranking switches to a post-rest service (stretch_video), content still resolves via a content-supported service at a lower fit than mid-drive

measured.top_name: チョコレイト・ディスコ — Perfume

label.en: E · 4/4 — Back on the road, calmer
label.ja: E・4/4 — 再出発、落ち着いた車内

brief.en: Back on the highway, calmer than the restless hour but past the fresh start (drowsiness 35). The same child-present track resumes the top spot and humming_karaoke leads the service ranking again -- the family's baseline reasserts itself.
brief.ja: 高速道路に戻り、落ち着かない1時間よりは穏やかだが出発直後ほど新鮮でもない（眠気35）。同じ子ども同乗の曲が再び首位となり、humming_karaokeが再びサービスランキングを主導 — 家族のベースラインが戻る。

expectation.hypothesis: back on the road, calmer than stage 2 but past the fresh start -> the same child track resumes the top spot and humming_karaoke leads service again

measured.top_name: チョコレイト・ディスコ — Perfume

driver_note: A teenage Hatsune Miku superfan (registered oshi, oshi_mode on, heavy vocaloid/j-pop usage + rich per-track history on all 3 Miku tracks). This is the ONE journey with a PREFERENCE lever plus the entity gate: the oshi's own track should top every stage regardless of the rising road pressure (situation amplifies the fit, it doesn't swap the winner), and at the after-rest stage the registered-oshi entity gate should open oshi_reexperience into the ranked services.

label.ja: イベントへ出発、テンション爆上がり

brief.en: She's leaving hours before showtime, playlist already blasting — tonight is the Hatsune Miku live she's dreamed about, and drowsiness (~30) is barely on the radar. Her Miku oshi signal plus heavy vocaloid/j-pop usage push Miku's own track to the top from the very first mile.
brief.ja: 本番の何時間も前に家を出る、プレイリストはもう全開——今夜は夢見た初音ミクのライブ、眠気（約30）なんて眼中にない。ミク推しシグナルとボカロ/J-POPの多用で、走り出した瞬間からミク自身の曲が首位に。

expectation.hypothesis: teens Miku superfan + vocaloid/j-pop usage, low drowsiness (~30) -> Miku's own track tops strongly despite minimal road/fatigue pressure

label.ja: 高速道路、テンション上昇中

brief.en: An hour into the drive, drowsiness has crept up a little (~40) and the road has gone monotonous (~45) — but the anticipation for tonight only grows. Miku's track still tops, and its fit is now even higher: the mild road pressure adds to preference rather than overriding it.
brief.ja: 走行1時間、眠気はわずかに上昇（約40）、道は単調に（約45）——それでも今夜への期待は高まるばかり。ミクの曲は変わらず首位、フィットはさらに上昇：軽い走行負荷が嗜好を上書きするのではなく上乗せされる。

expectation.hypothesis: drowsiness/monotony nudged up (40/45) on the same neutral-ish highway -> the oshi track stays top and its fit RISES further, not swaps -- situation adds to preference's magnitude

brief.en: The excitement hasn't stopped the fatigue: drowsiness has spiked to 90 and monotony is pinned at 80 after a long stretch of highway. The assistant recommends a stop before the venue — but Miku's track is now at its highest fit of the whole drive: preference and rising drowsiness reinforce the same pick instead of fighting it.
brief.ja: 興奮していても疲労は止まらない：長い高速走行の末、眠気は90まで急上昇し単調度は80に張り付く。会場前に休憩を推奨——それでもミクの曲はドライブ中で最も高いフィットを記録：嗜好と眠気の上昇が対立せず同じ選曲を後押しする。

expectation.hypothesis: before_rest at high drowsiness (90) + fatigue (55) -> the oshi track's fit peaks for the journey (situation amplifies rather than overrides preference), service stays among the driving set

brief.en: Parked at the venue lot at night, drowsiness has dropped to 35 and fatigue to 8 after the short stop -- the rest_spot_type is now the dedicated 'oshi_spot'. The content story switches to full-karaoke scoring for the same Miku track, and the service ranking now includes oshi_reexperience among the after-rest options -- the entity gate opens because this driver has a registered oshi.
brief.ja: 夜、会場の駐車場に停車。短い休憩の後、眠気は35、疲労は8まで低下——rest_spot_typeは専用の「oshi_spot」に。コンテンツは同じミクの曲をフルカラオケ向けに採点し直し、休憩後のサービス候補に oshi_reexperience が加わる——このドライバーは推しを登録済みのためエンティティゲートが開く。

expectation.hypothesis: after_rest at the oshi_spot, night, low drowsiness/fatigue -> content re-scores the same Miku track for full-karaoke and still tops on oshi identity; the registered-oshi entity gate opens oshi_reexperience into the after-rest service ranking
